description: Sandbox egress restriction: direct HTTPS from the build sandbox cannot reach api.elections.kalshi.com (SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL on connect; DNS resolves), while github.com/api.github.com are reachable. Evidence collection in this session therefore goes through the platform's server-side fetch route; every collected file records the tool used in its provenance sidecar and is SHA-256 bound, so the bytes are identical regardless of route. The GitHub Actions collector (forward-desk.yml) runs on runners with normal egress and is the permanent route.
status: environmental - no action for data integrity
detail: Re-verified per cycle by scripts/probe_endpoints.py in CI; if the official API moves hosts, the publish job fails rather than publishing unverified data.

description: The platform fetch proxy failed intermittently during this session with server-side OSS errors (InvalidAccessKeyId on the proxy's own storage), returning error XML instead of the target response. Mitigation: only successful responses with parsable JSON bodies are ever committed; failed responses are retried, and a failure is never written into the evidence directories.
detail: If collection stalls, the season board simply shows fewer cycles — no data integrity risk because nothing downstream reads failed payloads.

description: The CandleCharts contest page (specials.candlecharts.com/contest) was cited from the project brief and a search result but not fully retrieved this session; only its existence as a paper-contest reference is recorded.
detail: Flagged so the citation is not mistaken for a read source. CI link probe (scripts/probe_links.py) reports reachability; a full read is queued for the next session.
